one_line: Nvidia faces leadership turmoil and export scrutiny, SoftBank records billions in losses, and Anthropic's IPO draws heavy demand.

themes.title: Nvidia board plans CEO ouster
themes.text: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang following reports of personal relationships, prompting congressional calls to preserve export and spy-allegation records. Meanwhile, US regulators are moving to finalize rules blocking remote AI chip access for Chinese firms.

stories.headline: Nvidia stock drops as board reportedly prepares to oust CEO Jensen Huang
Nvidia board prepares to oust CEO Jensen Huang amid scandal
Senators ask Trump administration to preserve Nvidia-China records
House Republicans push for Nvidia's Jensen Huang to testify over spy allegations
Commerce Department finalizes rule to block remote AI chip access for China
Chinese AI firms rush to secure overseas Nvidia compute capacity amid US curb fears

themes.title: SoftBank writes off data center gear
themes.text: SoftBank wrote off $3.7 billion in unused gas turbines intended for AI data centers and recorded a $1.3 billion loss on OpenAI warrants. Separately, CoreWeave plans a $4 billion loan facility, chip startup Fractile raised $720 million at a $7 billion valuation, and Torus raised $500 million for modular container-sized data centers.

stories.headline: SoftBank writes off $3.7B from unused gas turbines for AI data centres
CoreWeave plans $4B+ investment-grade loan after raising revenue forecast
UK-backed AI chip startup Fractile hits $7 billion valuation
Torus raises $500M to build modular container-sized AI data centers

themes.title: India becomes ChatGPT's largest market
themes.text: India has become ChatGPT's largest global market by weekly active users, prompting OpenAI to introduce API inference residency for GPT-6 Luna in the country. Additionally, Indian lab Chariot launched a multilingual text-to-speech model supporting 11 Indian languages.

stories.headline: OpenAI adds API inference residency for GPT-6 Luna in India
India is now ChatGPT's largest market globally by weekly active users
Chariot launches multilingual TTS model with support for 11 Indian languages

themes.title: AI agents launch tools and restrictions
themes.text: AWS released an emulator tool built entirely by AI agents without human-written code. Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API for multimodal choice scoring, and United Airlines banned unauthorized third-party AI agents from booking travel.

stories.headline: AWS releases AWS Emulator built entirely by AI agents
Google launches Gemini Decisions API for fast multimodal yes/no and choice scoring
United Airlines bars unauthorized AI agents from booking travel
